# The management API (Opem API 1.0.0)

Server-to-server calls with a project's secret key: `Authorization: Bearer sk_…`. Professional and Enterprise plans only; on other plans every call is refused with `403` and `plan_limit_reached`. 120 calls a minute per key. The live document is `https://support.opem.app/api/openapi.json`; `@opem/node` wraps these calls (`createManagementClient`, `syncDocuments`).

### PUT /api/v1/manage/knowledge/documents

Sync documents by path

Up to 100 documents of up to 512 KB each. With prune, synced documents whose path is neither sent nor in keepPaths are deleted; uploaded and authored documents never are.

| `documents[].content` | string | yes |  |  |
| `prune` | boolean | no |  | default false |

### POST /api/v1/manage/requests/{requestId}/messages

Reply to a request from the customer's server

A staff message on channel `api`, relayed by email as a dashboard reply would be. The author is named by the first word of `authorName` only.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

Body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 5000 characters |
| `authorName` | string | yes | The staff member the reply is from. Only the first word is stored and shown to the person, as their first name, as for every staff reply; a value holding an email address shows as the project's name instead. | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `close` | boolean | no |  | default false |

## Error codes the management API returns

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `unauthenticated` | 401 | No valid credential for this surface |
| `plan_limit_reached` | 403 | The plan does not allow this, or a limit is reached |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing with that id in the caller's scope |
| `validation_failed` | 422 | The request does not match the contract |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests; try again shortly |

Every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId", "issues"? } }`; match on `code`, never on `message`.
